scope: Actual single cropped I arm clamped at core, rigid normal flat-wall compression/unloading; no full-key sliding/friction, coupled four-arm body, insertion force or printed holding rating.

assumptions.manufacturing: Flat, 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.2 mm layers, 2 walls, 7% adaptive cubic; local arm coverage inspected, not isotropy/bonding validation

mesh_comparison.decision: Both below provisional strain screen; force stable, local peak strain still mesh sensitive. First physical fit trial only.

diagnostics.sharp_pad_prescribed_diagnostic: Completed but strain rejected; sharp geometry and prescribed local pad motion differ from final contact fixture. No single-cause attribution.
diagnostics.spaced_key_fine_rejected: Earlier 0.3 mm-seam geometry completed but finer-mesh strain exceeded provisional 1.5%; not final I geometry.
diagnostics.fine_runtime_stop: 180-second execution timeout, not native convergence failure. Extended diagnostic completed separately.

physical_status: 2026-10-03: user reports keys 1/2/3 printed and all working; number 3 feels better, reason unknown. Actual print hashes/material/settings and detailed release/recovery/dwell checks unconfirmed. Full-box use remains unreported; no force/material calibration.
